rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for doing something cheerfully.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hoi1 sam1 gam2 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this when you want to emphasize a visibly happy, carefree manner.

example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hoi1 hoi1 sam1 sam1 gam2 king1 gai2

rows.note: Use this when the cheerfulness is conveyed specifically by smiling while doing something.

example.english: They cheerfully told me the good news with a smile.
example.traditional: 佢笑住同我講呢個好消息。
example.jyutping: keoi5 siu3 zyu6 tung4 ngo5 gong2 ni1 go3 hou2 siu1 sik1
